rule: PROBLEM-INTAKE-1: when no problem has been added for `gap_days`, every candidate here is measured against its international target with the same World Bank world series and shortfall rule as the catalogue, and the one with the largest measured shortfall joins the catalogue. Code picks; nobody chooses by hand.

candidates.title: Malaria
candidates.target_src: WHO Global Technical Strategy for Malaria: 90% lower than 2015

candidates.title: Anaemia in women
candidates.target_src: WHO global nutrition target: half the 2012 level

candidates.title: Children dangerously thin for their height
candidates.target_src: WHO and UNICEF 2030 nutrition target: below 3%

candidates.title: Children missing basic vaccines
candidates.unit: % of one-year-olds with three DTP doses

candidates.title: Births without a skilled attendant
candidates.unit: % of births attended by skilled health staff
candidates.target_src: Ending Preventable Maternal Mortality target: 90% of births

candidates.title: Children who do not finish lower secondary school
candidates.target_src: SDG 4.1: every child completes secondary education

candidates.title: People without essential health services
candidates.target_src: SDG 3.8 monitoring: coverage index of at least 80
